summary: Frontend-only verification of two iteration-22 features. BOTH PASS. (1) Admin Calendar '+N daha' → Day Events Dialog: seeded 5 events (2 video_cekimi, 2 kamp, 1 bulusma) on 2026-09-18 via POST /api/calendar/events; on /admin/calendar the 18 Eylül cell shows 3 tiles + a '+2 daha' button (data-testid='more-events-btn-2026-09-18'). Clicking it opens a dialog titled '18 Eylül 2026' containing all 5 rows (data-testid='day-event-item-<id>') each colored by type with icon/label (🎬 for video_cekimi yellow, 🏕️ orange 'TEST Kamp'/'TEST Kamp 2', ☕ pink 'Buluşma'). Clicking a row closes the day dialog and opens 'Etkinlik Düzenle - 18 Eylül' with correct Etkinlik Tipi selected. Cleanup: all 5 events DELETEd (HTTP 200). (2) Teacher Homework 'Kitaplar' → All-Books Dialog: logged in as ilknur.uzunal, dismissed 'Planlama Hatırlatması' modal, navigated to /teacher/students/aaf2775f-.../homework/2014af77-... (Ali Yılmaz Türkçe). 'Kitaplar' heading is now a button (data-testid='open-all-books-btn'); clicking opens dialog (data-testid='all-books-dialog') with header 'Ali Yılmaz - Kütüphane', 'Toplam 1 kitap', 'Ortalama: 0%', a single row (data-testid='all-books-item-2a63f17c-...') showing name 'Yeni kitap Türkçe', publisher 'TR evi', progress bar and '0%' (matches left-panel 0%). Clicking the row closes the dialog. 'Kapat' button present (close-all-books-btn). Only 1 book was available for the ilknur teacher branch, so the multi-book average path was not exercised, but list rendering + click-to-select + close all work.
